structured_output.what_is_happening: This is not a memecoin. It is the canonical Solana version of ApeCoin (APE), the Bored Ape Yacht Club ecosystem token. The mint C1MH...rFP1f was first published by the official @apecoin X account in September 2025 (https://x.com/apecoin/status/1965528309066088591). On 2026-09-22, Wormhole Labs' Sunrise gateway listed it as a canonical NTT (Native Token Transfers) SPL token. Supply on Solana is backed by APE locked on Ethereum. Sunrise announced the listing at 17:22 UTC and Raydium opened the market at 17:43 UTC (https://solanacompass.com/news/apecoin-ape-goes-live-on-solana-as-a-canonical-token-via-sunrise-trading-open-on-raydium). The pool in the packet was created at 17:18 UTC. The trigger is listing-day volume: about $10.3M on this pair within about 2.5 hours. Solana Compass reports $17.7M of volume, about 206k trades, 19,847 traders and 9,126 holders as of 19:15 UTC. The article is dated the 22nd but labels those figures 'first 24 hours', so they probably cover all APE venues on Solana. That does not fit neatly with a pool about 2.5 hours old. The same day, StonkFun (LaunchOnSF) started accepting APE as a base pair for new memecoin launches. The $190k market cap in the packet counts only the APE supply currently bridged to Solana. It does not describe the asset's real size. APE is a large-cap token with global price discovery on CEXs and Ethereum. The Solana price ($0.159) roughly matches the reported global price (about $0.14 on MetaMask: https://metamask.io/price/apecoin), so arbitrage anchors it.

narrative.description: Wormhole/Sunrise brought an established large-cap token (BAYC's ApeCoin) to Solana as a canonical token, with a Raydium market and APE usable as a memecoin launchpad base pair. This is part of ApeCoin's 'R.A.I.D' multi-chain expansion.
narrative.why_spreading: The attention comes from a real, verifiable infrastructure event: the listing by Sunrise, Raydium's confirmation, news coverage and the official ApeCoin account. Similar Sunrise listings (PEPE: $40M in its first 24h, https://solanacompass.com/news/pepe-lands-on-solana-as-a-canonical-spl-token-via-wormhole-ntt-hits-40m-volume-in-24-hours) show a big day-one spike. Launch-day activity usually peaks early. Price is set by the global APE market, not by the Solana narrative.

token_connection.why_this_token: The official @apecoin X account posted this exact contract address in 2025. Solana Compass names it as the canonical Sunrise NTT mint. It is listed on OKX and Bitget wallets under this address. The packet's project links (apechain.com, x.com/apecoin, the ApeCoin DAO Discord) match.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 'Evil Ape' (2Wki...pump) has about $1.2k of hourly volume, and a dead 'APE' token (952g...) has zero liquidity. Neither competes. There are also older Raydium APE pools (e.g. 4wn9uxrz…).

authenticity.evidence: The event is real and first-party: the Sunrise/Wormhole listing, Raydium going live and the official ApeCoin CA post (solanacompass, x.com/apecoin). Traffic is broad: about 10.9k unique buyers and 9.4k unique sellers over 6h. GMGN flags (1000 'bundlers', 340 smart wallets, 49 renowned wallets, a dexscreener boost, 'community_takeover', a creator with 103 launches) look scary but most likely reflect bridge, market-maker and arbitrage infrastructure plus the standard NTT setup. Mint authority stays enabled because the NTT manager must mint and burn against locked supply. They are poor indicators for a bridged large-cap.
authenticity.uncertainty: Much of the $10M of volume is probably arbitrage and MEV bots working the new pool against CEX prices (about 30% bot/degen rate, and turnover of about 50x the Solana-side market cap). That is not retail attention. The GMGN creator fields (103 launches, ATH mcap of $575M) are unexplained and may reflect the deployer or bridge key. I did not verify them.

structural_risks: Mint authority is enabled. This is expected for NTT, where supply is minted against APE locked on Ethereum, but it means Solana supply can grow as people bridge in.
The top 10 hold about 51%, which likely includes the Raydium pool and bridge/custody accounts.
Price is pinned to the global APE market by arbitrage, so Solana-specific attention cannot re-rate it much.
The market cap figure is misleading because it counts only bridged supply. The actual asset is large-cap.
LP is not locked (0%), which is typical for a protocol-seeded pool.

structured_output.counterargument: Canonical listings plus the StonkFun base-pair integration can keep volume up for days. New memecoins paired to APE must route buys through this pool, and ApeCoin's R.A.I.D campaign and ApeFest-style events could keep marketing going. If global APE rallies on ecosystem news, the Solana pool would get more volume and attention, not less. Also, the Solana-side 'market cap' will likely grow as more APE is bridged in, which could look like 'continuation' on the metric even while price is flat.
unknowns: How much of the volume is arbitrage and MEV rather than retail
Whether ApeCoin/Sunrise are running liquidity or trading incentives
How much StonkFun APE-pair activity has actually launched
The unexplained GMGN creator metadata (103 launches, dev X account with 226 tokens)
The global APE price direction over the next day, which will dominate this token's price

source_coverage.notes: The official @apecoin CA post and the Bankr bot posts were found through search. The news is Solana Compass and The Block's coverage of Sunrise. No Reddit threads turned up. I did not open Telegram or Discord. The DAO Discord invite is in the packet but not viewable without logging in. Project identity was confirmed through the sunrise.xyz and apechain links in search results, not a direct fetch of the site.

structured_output.thesis: The trigger is launch-day volume on the verified canonical Solana version of ApeCoin, listed through Wormhole's Sunrise gateway. The event is real and first-party, the token is canonical, and ticker-hijack risk is low. But this is a large-cap token bridged to Solana, and arbitrage pins its price to global APE. The unusual volume is mostly launch novelty plus arbitrage and MEV rebalancing, and that typically decays after day one. Solana-specific attention is unlikely to keep growing enough to move price on its own.
